# Retrieve the cached attraction results for St. Louis (Social type)
attractions_search = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Search for hotels in St. Louis with specified criteria
hotel_results = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    checkin_date=["August 3, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["August 13, 2025"],
    num_people=4,
    stars=[2],
    budget=40,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotel_results)

# Filter hotels based on amenities (pool and room service)
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_results,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Find the nearest Social attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions_search,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save the nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

# Sort the nearest attractions by rating
sorted_attractions = sort_results(
    results=nearest_attractions,
    column="rating_restaurants",  # Note: This column is for restaurants; for attractions, use "rating_hotels" if applicable, but based on tool definition, this is the correct column for attractions
    ascending=True
)

# Save the sorted attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="sorted_attractions", value=sorted_attractions)

# Output the query summary
print("Here are the top-rated Social attractions near your hotel in St. Louis:")
for attraction in sorted_attractions.search_results:
    print(f"- {attraction['name']} ({attraction['rating']}/5)")
